assertions.name: archimedean_falsifier_match
assertions.source: sympy exact, n = 1..8: ∫₀^∞ s^n e^(−s) ds/s = (n−1)! per order, and the finite-order polynomial identity ∫₀^∞ [Σ b_n (xs)^n] e^(−s) ds/s = Σ B_n x^n holds exactly in x — the corpus's normalizer strip IS order-by-order integration against the unit Schwinger kernel at q = 1. FALSIFIER PASSES (a mismatch would have killed the identification)

assertions.name: fibre_canonical_choice_not_pinned
assertions.source: q = 1.2, 60 dps + sympy-exact reindex/symmetry identities: the u-translated theta factor (atoms u·q̃^j, masses ∝ q̃^(−j(j+1)/2)·u^(−j)) has u-INDEPENDENT moments q^(k(k−1)/4) (rel < 1e−30 at u = 1 and u = 1.3; exact mechanism jk − j(j+1)/2 = k(k−1)/2 − i(i+1)/2), with support distinct from the u = 1 grid (grid offset 0.12196 of a q̃-step). The bar-reflection σ: s ↦ q̃^(−1)/s — the unique reflection fixing both Attack-B B-factor realizations (theta u = 1 via j ↦ −1−j exact; log-normal via Gaussian symmetry, sympy) — maps μ_u ↦ μ_(1/u) (measure equality < 1e−28), and the symmetrization ½(μ_u + μ_(1/u)) is positive, σ-invariant, atomic, same moments, giving after Jackson-convolution a u-CONTINUUM of positive kernels with exactly the balanced moments N^bal(k+1) (rel < 1e−30). CONSEQUENCE: positivity + balanced moments + bar-reflection-invariance + atomicity do NOT pin the fibre kernel — (REP)'s canonical choice needs a derivation input beyond moments + symmetry (RSZ §1.2.1 kernel non-canonicity; at q = 1 the class IS a singleton by Carleman, Attack A)

description: Attack 1 on (REP) — the last substantive hypothesis of conj:schwinger-measure-computational-time (bean qou-u5p0; audit-only, scope-(a), NO FIT, nothing wired). DETERMINATION (audit §1, corpus survey): the corpus performs NO integral resummation of the binding OGF — production binding is the finite Markov-trace evaluation (mass_binding_dashboard.py, canonical_mass.py); the OGF appears only formally (keystone strip, coefficient-level q-Borel, growth diagnostics). Hence (REP) is a canonical-CHOICE claim, not a matching to an existing corpus integral. R1: the corpus formal operation (involution periods B_n = I(n)/n, strip N(n) = (n−1)! forced by n·N(n) = n!, depth-2 recurrence) verified exact. R2 (falsifier, archimedean): the strip IS order-by-order integration against e^(−s)·ds/s — per-order moments AND the finite-order polynomial identity exact (sympy) — MATCH. R3 (falsifier, fibre; q = 1.2 + both q₀ pins): the Jackson⊛theta atomic kernel's ds/s-moments equal N^bal(n) = q^(−(n−1)(n−2)/4)[n−1]_q! (rel < 1e−30) and the q-lift C1 carrier resums through the kernel correctly at finite order; the exact gap to the corpus's proved one-sided strip is the Attack-E bar-covariant weight — MATCH in the balanced convention. R4 (the new content): the u-translate/reflection/symmetrization construction exhibits a u-CONTINUUM of positive, bar-reflection-invariant, ATOMIC kernels sharing all balanced moments (exact reindex mechanism; 60 dps cross-checks) — positivity + moments + bar-symmetry + atomicity do NOT pin the kernel at q ≠ 1 (sharpens Attack B §3.1 from 'two realizations' to 'a continuum inside the symmetric atomic class'); at q = 1 the class is a singleton (Carleman, Attack A, cited). RSZ (Astérisque 355) §1.2.1 states kernel non-canonicity and gives no general explicit integral formula for its ch. 5 summation — no 'RSZ classification' pins the theta kernel as the unique bar-invariant choice. Nothing here proves or refutes the conjecture.
